ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Ltd. (Scrip Code: 500013)**  Ansal Properties & Infrastructure Ltd. is currently undergoing a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) specifically confined to its projects and assets located in Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan. A recent NCLT order (November 19, 2026) has further delineated this process by appointing separate Resolution Professionals (RPs) for the Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan segments, along with a common supervisor, to manage the geographically distinct assets. While this aims to streamline the complex resolution of fragmented real estate projects, the company's continued operation under partial insolvency proceedings highlights significant financial and operational challenges.
